div.div:
Usage limit hit
5-hour window used up:
turns fail with
model_usage_exhausted
or paymentRequired; nothing
runs until the reset
Every project tick (10 min) · usage-limit.sh first

div.div:
1 · Detect
next tick that runs: check <ws>
reads the last turn outcome
of the orchestrator and each
agent; records the earliest
stop and the reset

2 · Back off
only a tick that runs before
the reset (check says active):
starts no agents, sends no
messages, writes its
heartbeat and stops

text.tspan: only a tick that runs before

div.div:
3 · Resume
first tick after the reset:
check says resume and lists
each interrupted agent; the
orchestrator messages
each one once

Clear
resumed <ws> <ids> marks the
stops handled; with none left,
the limit clears. Or check
clears it alone when no
agent needs a message

Sent once to each listed agent
"Your last turn stopped at the usage limit. … Continue your last task from where it stopped. … Don't start over."
Not listed: idle or finished agents, agents already restarted, the orchestrator (its next tick restarts it)
